factors: unchanged R03 dedt symmetric YoY change and margin YoY pp delta; latest comparable quarter; same-date conflicts missing, no update_flag arbitrary tie-breaking
aggregation: R03 previous-month members, >=5 valid and >=80% denominator for each field
comparisons: F vs C vs FCfund; report each delay's coverage and exact common industry/date cohort across all3 delays. Compute all centered ranks within matched cohort, avoid interpreting sample differences as information effect
outcomes: same next-close delayed20/60 CSI_ALL-relative returns; minimum20 cross-section; record unknown outcomes; no fitting
extra_audits: count same-date conflicting values including missing vs numeric, effective dates before period end, current/prior deducted-profit sign regimes and zero denominator; archived mode coverage separately
acceptance: descriptive only because at most5 primary mature months; no incremental efficacy claim or selection of best delay
refutation: historical association vanishes or reverses under delay; positive appearance comes from changing sample; sign changes or restatements dominate
limits: lags cannot restore missing original vintages; causal mechanism and fixed-FY analyst expectations are not tested
